_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: the corners (always 8) or the number of small cubes (n³); 2: cubes with two faces painted (on the edges) or none (inside); 3: cubes with one face painted, or only one colour (the middle of a face); 4: cubes with two or three particular colours, which first needs the faces to be next to each other or opposite. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
